name: Valsartan
contraindications: Pregnancy (contraindicated), bilateral renal artery stenosis, known hypersensitivity
interactions: NSAIDs may reduce antihypertensive effect and increase renal risk; avoid combined use with other RAS blockers; potassium supplements/ potassium-sparing diuretics increase hyperkalaemia risk; lithium levels may rise
monitoring: Check eGFR and serum potassium at baseline and 1–2 weeks after initiation or dose changes; monitor blood pressure and signs of renal impairment
pregnancy: Contraindicated during pregnancy; discontinue as soon as pregnancy is confirmed and seek specialist advice
sideEffects: Dizziness, hypotension, hyperkalaemia, possible renal impairment; rare angioedema
clinicalPearls: Useful alternative to ACE inhibitors in patients who develop cough; monitor renal function closely when used with diuretics or NSAIDs
indication: Hypertension and heart failure where ARB therapy is indicated
